messages:
mina: FYI brought Flare9B (hf checkpoint) through our int8 pipeline. seeing severe long-context degradation on code summarization and doc-gen beyond ~800 tokens. short prompts OK.

liam: can you share quant flags + quick reproducer?

mina: reproducer below:
```
rwd-convert --src flare9b/fp16.ckpt --dst flare9b-int8.quant --method per_channel_int8 --block-size 128 --calib-samples 1500
rwd-infer --model flare9b-int8.quant --task code-sum --prompt-file tests/long_examples/large_class.py --max-tokens 2048 --dump-attn heads=all
```
Logs show attention heads in later layers drop to near-zero energy after ~850 tokens.

(sophia): head collapse usually means scale computed across wrong axis or qkv layout mismatch. any metadata in checkpoint about qkv_layout or head-dim ordering?

mina: checkpoint.metadata has qkv_layout: "nhp" which I assumed converter canonicalizes. converter debug: "canonicalizing qkv layout" but i see scale tensors computed with shape [n_heads, head_dim] vs expected [head_dim, n_heads] in the int8 path.

quant-bot: quick check: computed per-channel scale histogram: majority OK but 6 heads have scales < 1e-6.

liam: sounds like an axis bug. try forcing --qkv-layout hnp on convert and recompute scales. also add a per-head clamp min e.g. 1e-4 to avoid underflow.

mina: running two probes: A) --qkv-layout hnp, no clamp; B) --qkv-layout hnp + --per-channel-scale-clamp 1e-4.

ci-bot: job 52244 queued (node=gpu-c2), est 8m

[7m later]

mina: results (subset 50 long examples):
- orig int8 => repeat@800: 45/50, ROUGE-code 39.8, p50 118ms
- int8 (qkv_layout=hnp) => repeat@800: 8/50, ROUGE-code 56.1, p50 121ms
- int8 (qkv_layout=hnp + clamp=1e-4) => repeat@800: 6/50, ROUGE-code 57.0, p50 122ms
- fp16 baseline => repeat@800: 4/50, ROUGE-code 59.3, p50 210ms

sophia: clear signal. primary root cause qkv-layout mismatch during scale computation. clamp helps but layout fix is primary.

liam: action items: 1) fail conversion if computed scale histogram shows >2 heads with scale < threshold (gate in CI), 2) require explicit qkv-layout override when checkpoint.metadata.qkv_layout present and differs from expected in non-interactive conversions, 3) add tiny long-context smoke (2 examples) to onboarding suite for code models.

mina: opening PR with fixes and tests. will also add per-head pre-quant norms to artifact so downstream can decide head-exclusion for awq/int4.

ci-bot: PR #8245 opened (converter: qkv-layout safeguard + scale-gate + longctx smoke).
